notes: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics platform) evaluating Redwood primarily for embeddings/semantic search. Current stack: product backend in GCP, metadata in BigQuery, vector store: Pinecone (single-region). Goals: reduce latency for user queries (<150ms query P50), scale nightly batch vectorization (target 1.5-2M docs/night), lower unit cost per embedding and storage. They like Redwood Hosted API for quick integration; interest in Dedicated once we demonstrate throughput and predictable cost. Key asks: vector DB integration patterns (can Redwood route embeddings to Pinecone/Weaviate or prefer native store?), connectors to S3/BigQuery for batch jobs, incremental reindex workflows, and clear pricing for reserved GPU pools. Security: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) must be in place before prod, customer wants audit logs and KMS/BYOK. Procurement timeline: finance review mid-March. SE notes: prioritize a short benchmark run showing Dedicated latency under 120ms at 50 QPS and a batch job demonstrating 2k-3k vectors/sec sustained. Quote requested for 6-month reserved capacity and example cost model for monthly steady-state + burst. POC feedback: "search relevance improved on long-tail queries" per PM, but infra flagged egress and VPC peering tasks.
